_comment: Single source of truth for utilization denominators. Kept in sync with
docs/environment-matrix.md — that file explains the numbers, this one is
what tools/plot.py reads, so a figure can never disagree with the doc.
bw_theoretical_gbps: vendor/derived peak. Answers 'how far from the hardware'.
bw_ceiling_*_gbps:   best of read/copy/write from bench-probe on that machine,
measured with the same cold/hot discipline as the kernels.
Answers 'how far from a well-written trivial kernel'.
null until bench-probe has been run there.
Compare like with like: cold numbers against bw_ceiling_cold_gbps, hot against hot.
